review_note: Joint mu (1 | id) with sd(id) ~ w plus a sigma random effect on site with its own SD predictor. Test 1 fits sigma ~ 1 + (0 + z | site), which supports the sigma:x1..xp slope row, slope member only (pure slope fit, no sigma intercept field). Test 2 fits sigma ~ 1 + (1 | site), which supports sigma:I. Both tests fit mu:I. The oracle is a base-R dense Laplace for the Gaussian with a sigma random effect (no closed form exists), with SD vectors built by hand from the coefficients, tolerance 1e-4, gradient and Hessian sanity checks included. Four bugs (reversed mu SD, reversed sigma SD, swapped selector coefficients, predictor ignored) each move it by more than 0.1 and pass.
